feature: SQL "hello world" — proves a headless build agent can trigger + read back a real SQL result end to end
notes: Part of Epic #803. Purpose is NOT to test real product logic — it proves the
automation pipeline itself (headless trigger -> #896's sql-test endpoint -> real
row value read back) works, so more complex manifests can be trusted.
Must be triggered via #898's remote-trigger-over-HTTP path (POST /admin/deploy/test-run,
polled at GET /admin/deploy/test-run/<runId>), not run manually through BuildConsole's UI.
Asserts on the REAL returned value, not just success/no-error: `SELECT 1 AS ping` runs through
#896's POST /admin/deploy/sql-test as an apiTest, and jsonPath `$.rows[0].ping` must literally
equal 1 — a query that ran without erroring but returned the wrong value must still fail.
